1.title: Trump Gets Caught in a Dilemma Over a Saudi Plea for Military Help
1.summary: The president vacillated but decided on Sunday not to join Saudi Arabia, for now, in joint strikes against the Houthis in Yemen. But he also needs the kingdom’s cooperation in his war against Iran.

2.title: ICE Agent Shoots Venezuelan Immigrant in Austin, Local Authorities Say
2.summary: The shooting in the Texas capital is the latest by federal immigration agents as the Trump administration intensifies its deportation effort.

3.title: Republican Who Runs South Dakota Elections Backs Democrat to Succeed Her
3.summary: Monae Johnson, the secretary of state, is the latest Republican incumbent to speak out against conservative candidates as President Trump loses support before midterm elections.

4.title: On a Dot of France Off Canada, Carney and Macron Talk Partnership
4.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney of Canada and President Emmanuel Macron of France met just after the European Union invited Canada to become its first “associate member.”

5.title: Thirty More Arrested in Jovenel Moïse Assassination
5.summary: The suspects in the 2021 assassination of President Jovenel Moïse include 18 men who were extradited from Haiti to Miami, officials said.

6.title: A Diplomat From Myanmar Refuses to Give Up New York City Post
6.summary: For more than five years, U Kyaw Moe Tun has refused to give up his United Nations post and a sandstone townhouse on the Upper East Side.
